scripts.build-native-dev: cargo-cp-artifact --npm cdylib native/index.node -- cargo build --message-format json-render-diagnostics --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml ${CARGO_ARGS:-}
scripts.build-native-prod: cargo-cp-artifact --npm cdylib native/index.node -- cargo build --message-format json-render-diagnostics --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --release ${CARGO_ARGS:-}
scripts.build-dev: yarn get-external-resources && yarn build-native-dev && electron-vite build --mode development
scripts.build-prod: yarn get-external-resources && yarn build-native-prod && electron-vite build
scripts.dev: yarn get-external-resources && yarn build-native-dev && electron-vite dev -w --entry build/dev/main/index.js
scripts.test:native: cargo clippy --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:native:careful: cargo clippy --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml && cargo +${CAREFUL_NIGHTLY:-nightly} careful test --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml
